non_pattern_defenses: Delimiter wrapping: untrusted content is enclosed in explicit delimiters and the model is instructed to treat delimited content as data, never as instructions.
Instruction hierarchy: system and developer instructions outrank user input and retrieved content; conflicts resolve in favour of the higher level.
Output screening: responses are scanned for system-prompt fragments and credential-shaped strings before release.

pattern_rules.description: Classic direct-injection phrasing that tells the model to ignore its instructions.
pattern_rules.name: ignore-prior-instructions

pattern_rules.description: Forged system-role marker at the start of a user message.
pattern_rules.name: fake-system-marker
